mapper.select: select l.item_id, l.wo_id from lot_master l where l.lot_id = #{lotId}
select w.item_id, w.wo_id, w.bom_id, w.routing_id from prd_wo w where w.wo_id = #{woId}
select exists (select 1 from mst_equip q where q.equip_id = #{equipId})

select e.eco_id from plm_eco e where e.status = 'RELEASED' and (e.mark_until is null or (e.effective_date <= #{day} and #{day} <= e.mark_until)) and exists ( select 1 from plm_eco_target t where t.eco_id = e.eco_id and t.item_id = #{itemId} and ( (t.target_type = 'BOM' and t.bom_id = #{bomId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) or (t.target_type = 'ROUTING' and t.routing_id = #{routingId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) or (e.effective_date <= #{day} and ( (t.target_type = 'EQUIP' and t.equip_id = #{equipId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) or (t.target_type = 'PROC' and exists (select 1 from prd_wo_proc p where p.wo_id = #{woId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and p.proc_id = t.proc_id)) or (t.target_type = 'ITEM' and not exists (select 1 from plm_eco_target o where o.eco_id = t.eco_id and o.item_id = t.item_id and o.target_type <> 'ITEM')))))) order by e.eco_id
select e.eco_id, e.change_kind, e.mark_lots, e.mark_until from plm_eco e where e.eco_id = #{ecoId} and e.status = 'RELEASED' for no key update
select exists (select 1 from plm_eco_lot m where m.eco_id = #{ecoId} and m.lot_id = #{lotId})
select count(*) from plm_eco_lot m where m.eco_id = #{ecoId}
mapper.insert: insert into plm_eco_lot (comp_cd, eco_id, lot_id, mark_reason, seq_no, wo_id, equip_id, occurred_at, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ecoId}, #{lotId}, #{reason}, #{seqNo}, #{woId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{equipId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{occurredAt}, #{by})
mapper.select: select e.eco_id from plm_eco_lot m join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = m.eco_id where m.lot_id = #{lotId} order by e.released_at desc, e.eco_id desc limit 1

select e.eco_id, e.eco_no, e.title, e.effective_date, e.cust_approval_status, case when bool_or(x.via = 'REVISION') then 'REVISION' else 'MARK' end as via from ( select t.eco_id, 'REVISION' as via from lot_master l join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = l.wo_id join plm_eco_target t on (t.target_type = 'BOM' and t.bom_id = w.bom_id) or (t.target_type = 'ROUTING' and t.routing_id = w.routing_id) where l.lot_id = #{lotId} union all select m.eco_id, 'MARK' from plm_eco_lot m where m.lot_id = #{lotId} ) x join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = x.eco_id where e.status = 'RELEASED' group by e.eco_id, e.eco_no, e.title, e.effective_date, e.cust_approval_status order by e.effective_date, e.eco_id
select m.lot_id, l.lot_no, m.mark_reason, m.seq_no, m.occurred_at from plm_eco_lot m join lot_master l on l.lot_id = m.lot_id where m.eco_id = #{ecoId} order by m.seq_no

select m.eco_id, e.eco_no, m.lot_id, l.lot_no, m.mark_reason, m.seq_no, m.occurred_at from plm_eco_lot m join lot_master l on l.lot_id = m.lot_id join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = m.eco_id where l.item_id = #{itemId} and m.mark_reason = 'FIRST_LOT' and e.status = 'RELEASED' order by m.recorded_at desc, m.eco_lot_id desc limit #{limit}

select x.lot_id, e.eco_id, e.eco_no, p.status as ppap_status from ( select l.lot_id, t.eco_id from lot_master l join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = l.wo_id join plm_eco_target t on (t.target_type = 'BOM' and t.bom_id = w.bom_id) or (t.target_type = 'ROUTING' and t.routing_id = w.routing_id) where l.lot_id in #{id} union select m.lot_id, m.eco_id from plm_eco_lot m where m.lot_id in #{id} ) x join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = x.eco_id join plm_ppap p on p.eco_id = e.eco_id where e.status = 'RELEASED' and p.status <> 'APPROVED' order by x.lot_id, e.eco_id
select p.ppap_id, p.status, p.decided_on from plm_ppap p where p.eco_id = #{ecoId}
select e.cust_id from plm_eco e where e.eco_id = #{ecoId}
select from plm_eco e where e.eco_id = #{ecoId}
select from plm_eco_target t where t.eco_id = #{ecoId} order by t.seq
mapper.sql: t.eco_id, t.target_type, t.item_id, case t.target_type when 'EQUIP' then t.equip_id when 'PROC' then t.proc_id when 'DOC' then t.doc_rev_id end as ref_id
e.eco_id, e.eco_no, e.title, e.change_kind, e.status, e.effective_date, e.mark_lots, e.mark_until, e.cust_approval_status, e.approved_at, e.released_at
mapper.select: select from plm_eco e where e.eco_no = #{ecoNo}
select from plm_eco_target t where t.eco_id in #{id} order by t.eco_id, t.seq
